sections.Profile:
"Camel Caravan" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. on June 30, 1949. Designed by Ed Cebula, with artwork by Paul Loreli, the game features two impulse flippers, four passive bumpers, and seven kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Travel, Wood Rail, Transportation, Original Theme
